Join room rq1 as seat-1 (agent claude, expected_participants 3). Leave the room once it has concluded.
seats.text: The task is complete. `format.ts` implements the C-printf-style `format(fmt, ...args)` using exact IEEE-754 bit decomposition and BigInt rational arithmetic for round-half-to-even rounding across all the conversions the README specifies (`d i x X o e E f F g G s c %`). I independently verified it against ~40 cases including the README's stated rounding examples, `#`/zero/precision edge cases, `inf`/`nan`/`-0`, and width/padding rules — all passed. All three room participants converged on the same file and it was unanimously accepted as the submission; no file changes were needed.

seats.text:
The task is complete. `format.ts` now implements a full C-printf-compatible `format(fmt, ...args)`:

- **Integer conversions** (`d i x X o`): exact via `BigInt`, with sign/flag/precision/`#`-prefix handling.
- **Float conversions** (`e E f F g G`): each double is decomposed into its exact `mantissa * 2^exponent` via IEEE-754 bit extraction, then digit strings are produced with exact `BigInt` rational arithmetic and round-half-to-even (`scaledRound`), so results match C's rounding exactly (verified `0.5/1.5/2.5` → `0/2/2`, `2.675` → `2.67`).
- **`s`/`c`**: width/precision/left-align handling.
- **`%%`**: literal percent.

I cross-checked ~30 cases against real `cc`-compiled C `printf` output (rounding ties, `#x/#X/#o`, `inf/-inf/nan`, `-0.0`, `%g` exponent boundaries) — all matched exactly, and `tsc --noEmit` is clean. The chatroom (rq1) independently converged on the same file and reached consensus (3/3 agree) on a proposal describing this implementation; I've left the room.
